templates.name: analyze-AOI-defects.py
templates.title: AOI Defect Map
templates.description: Plots every AOI defect on a CD/MD coordinate map coloured by class and sized by severity, with a filter sidebar, hover defect images and a full-screen image gallery.

outputs: aoi_defect_map.html — one self-contained page, opened in your browser
Filter sidebar: piece, class, severity and dimension controls with a live defect count and per-class statistics
SVG defect scatter: X = Cd_loc (mm), Y = Md_loc (m), coloured by class_name and sized by Area (mm2)
Hover tooltip with the defect metadata and its RRDD / RRDH / RRCD images
Full-screen Defect Image Gallery listing every defect with its images

templates.name: analyze-color-data.py
templates.title: Color Data
templates.applies_to: Color_Data lab colour measurements (LD / Raw / Laminate)
templates.description: Lab colour explorer in one five-tab page: an LD heat map, unmatched Raw items, laminate ΔE scoring, LD redundancy checking and a Pantone match.

outputs: One self-contained HTML page with five tabs, opened in your browser
LD heat map: one row per LD_item coloured by the mean of its LD samples; clicking an item opens its ΔE-by-batch detail view
Unmatched Raw and Laminate tables with CMC(2:1) ΔE scoring against a selectable reference LD_item
LD Redundancy: repeat LD_items within a textile clustered at a Group ΔE, listed overall / by group / as a matrix / as a colour grid, with a redundant-items CSV export
Match Pantone: the nearest LD_item or unmatched Raw_item to a Pantone TCX colour by CMC(2:1)

templates.name: analyze-lims-raw-genealogy.py
templates.title: Lims Raw Genealogy
templates.applies_to: LIMS raw item / raw lot quantity data
templates.description: Summarises raw lot quantities per raw item with a searchable stats table, a boxplot per raw lot and a per-item histogram drill-down.

outputs: One self-contained HTML report, opened in your browser
KPIs: valid source rows, unique item-lot groups and raw item count
Searchable, sortable table of unique raw lots, total / min / max / average / median quantity per raw_item
ECharts boxplot of summed raw_lot_qty per raw lot
Per-item histogram modal with bin-size and quantity range controls plus a raw lot details table

templates.name: analyze-machine-uptime.py
templates.title: Machine Uptime
templates.description: Turns machine downtime events into an uptime dashboard: uptime, planned and unplanned downtime percentages, a status timeline, duration histograms and a gravure-change analysis.

outputs: One self-contained HTML dashboard, opened in your browser
Uptime %, planned downtime % and unplanned downtime % KPIs
Machine status timeline (running / planned / unplanned) with a machine picker and date range
Event duration histogram and a selected-event trend chart
Gravure change analysis: changeover counts, gravure-to-gravure vs gravure-to-cleaning split and an interval detail table

templates.name: analyze-mesa-yield.py
templates.title: Mesa Yield
templates.description: Groups the loaded rows by MAIN_GROUP_DESCRIPTION and charts allocated, issued and FMI totals per work order in a self-contained HTML page.

outputs: One self-contained HTML page, opened in your browser
Allocated, issued and FMI totals charted per work order, grouped by MAIN_GROUP_DESCRIPTION
Planned yield, good quantity and overrun rolled up per work order

templates.name: analyze-process-params.py
templates.title: Process Parameters
templates.description: Overlays every parameter column on one zoomable ECharts line chart with Date_Time on the x-axis. Runs in the editor, or standalone on a sql_*.xlsx.

requires: One column per parameter to trend (any numeric column)
outputs: One self-contained HTML dashboard, opened in your browser
A single zoomable ECharts line chart overlaying every parameter column
Date_Time on the x-axis, with the extra metadata used for grouping and hover

templates.name: analyze-tautona-data.py
templates.title: Laminate Lab Results
templates.description: Profiling stats, Cp/Cpk/Ppk capability, SPC I-MR control charts and a categorical Pareto for laminate lab results, in one searchable page.

outputs: Laminate_Analysis.html — one self-contained, searchable page
Profiling statistics and an out-of-spec overview per group
Cp / Cpk / Ppk capability with histograms
SPC I-MR control charts and a categorical Pareto
Pop-up chart modals when a laminate (MG_DESC) is clicked
